root.label: Aminata Seck remains detained after case reopening

events.label: Aminata Seck remains detained after case reopening

slots.name: detention duration
slots.sentence: She has now been detained for nearly two months despite having no criminal history, significant family and community ties in the United States, and a record of pursuing her education and building her life here.

slots.name: custody status
slots.sentence: “She will remain in ICE custody pending removal proceedings,” the Department of Homeland Security wrote in a statement on Thursday.

slots.name: detention location
slots.sentence: Alsalman said that Seck is currently being held at the Grayson County Detention Center in Leitchfield, Kentucky, and is in solitary confinement because officials at the prison have “security concerns” with her knee brace being used as a weapon.

slots.name: entry date
slots.sentence: DHS said in a statement that Seck legally entered the United States in 2019, then “chose to overstay her welcome in violation of our nation’s laws.”

slots.name: age
slots.sentence: The 26-year-old Seck is from Dakar, Senegal’s capital.
